rules.text: Retaining Wall: The retaining wall(s) is {H2_RW_DEFECTS} and may present a potential safety hazard. As retaining walls support significant ground loads, failure could result in substantial damage and costly repairs. An appropriately qualified specialist should inspect the wall without delay and recommend any necessary remedial works. If the retaining wall is shared with the neighbouring property owner, they may have some rights. Before any work is done, you should ask your legal adviser to investigate this matter and explain the implications.

rules.text: Nearby Trees: One or more trees are located close to the property. Tree roots can, in certain ground conditions, influence foundations, particularly where mature trees are close to buildings and during prolonged dry periods.
No defects: No significant detrimental effects on the property were noted to date, although the trees should be regularly pruned to restrict future growth and minimise the risk of defects occurring.

Defects noted: One or more trees are located close to the property. Tree roots can, in certain ground conditions, influence foundations, particularly where mature trees are close to buildings and during prolonged dry periods. With groups of trees, the risk is usually greatest during prolonged dry spells. Detrimental effects on the {H2_TREE_AFFECTED} were noted that include {H2_TREE_DEFECT}. You should contact a qualified person for further investigation and advice. Also, the trees should be regularly pruned to restrict future growth and minimise the risk of further defects occurring.

rules.text: Subsoil: The exact nature of the subsoil has not been investigated as part of this survey. However, the subsoil in the area may include shrinkable clay. Where present, this type of subsoil can be susceptible to seasonal moisture changes, which may result in movement due to shrinking during dry periods and expansion during wetter conditions. Your legal adviser should confirm, where applicable, ownership of the shared areas, rights of access, maintenance responsibilities, service charge liabilities, and any restrictions affecting their use.
